penalties.details: An inspection was done by the environmental authority (PROFEPA) for the Company’s WOS, Industrias Quimicas Falcon de Mexico, S.A. During the inspection questions were raised on the final use and consumption report pertaining to the quantities imported of N-Heptane. On December 9th, 2025, the Company received a notification of fine of MXP $ 65,055.50 (INR 3,35,000/-) due to non-compliance of the condition IV of the permit no. DGGIMAR .710/000677.
penalties.impact: A fine of MXP $ 65,055.50 (INR 3,35,000/-) was levied. Based on the evaluation, there is no material impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of the Company.

operating_notes.text: Received Health Canada Notice of Compliance for generic Semaglutide Injection covering 2 mg/pen and 4 mg/pen strengths.
Launched generic Semaglutide Injection in Canada following Health Canada approval.
USFDA issued Form 483 with three observations following PAI at FTO-9 facility in Visakhapatnam
Received DCGI approval for Zytorvi (toripalimab) for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in India.
Q2FY27 North America revenue fell 23% YoY to ₹2,489 Cr largely due to lower lenalidomide sales.
CDMO business under Aurigene Pharmaceutical Services Limited generated revenues of over $100 million in the 12 months ended September 2026.
Certain batches of semaglutide were found to be out of specification due to an issue with the API used; measures being taken to resume supplies.

timeline.summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories received an exchange clarification request regarding a news item on pending approvals.
Dr. Reddy's clarifies that it has not yet received Health Canada approval for its Semaglutide Injection, though it has received DINs.
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories scheduled its Q4 and full year FY26 financial results announcement for May 12, 2026.
Dr. Reddy's received Health Canada approval for generic Semaglutide Injection on April 29, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,546.4 Cr (-11.5% YoY), net profit ₹221.3 Cr (-86.1% YoY).
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26 financial results.
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. shared the audio recording of its earnings call for Q4 FY2026, held on May 12, 2026, via **K. Randhir Singh**, CFO.
Dr. Reddy's launched its generic Semaglutide Injection in Canada on May 15, 2026, following Health Canada approval.
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. management, led by **K. Randhir Singh**, will attend Bank of America’s in-person investor group meet in Hyderabad on June 5, 2026, from 08:00–09:00 IST.
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. will attend ICICI Securities' Mumbai group meet on June 9, 2026, from 10:00–17:00 IST and Macquarie’s Hyderabad meet on June 10, 2026, from 12:00–13:00 IST.
2026-10-14: Dr. Reddy's receives USFDA Form 483 with three observations following PAI at FTO-9 facility
Dr. Reddy's received DCGI approval for Zytorvi (toripalimab) for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in India.
Dr. Reddy's reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹8,671 Cr, down 1.5% YoY, and PAT of ₹925 Cr, down 36% YoY.
2026-10-23: Dr. Reddy's reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹8,671 Cr, down 1.5% YoY, and PAT of ₹925 Cr, down 36% YoY, on lower lenalidomide sales in North America.
Audio recording of earnings call held on October 23, 2026 made available.
